task: Make Koala init generate Codex agent prompts from the full Claude agent prompt set.
outcome: After a user runs koala init in a project, their file tree shows .claude/agents and .Codex/agents containing the same Koala agent prompt names, including koala-implementer and koala-review-quality. The user no longer asks why Codex only got four files; .Codex/README.md explains that hooks/settings/skills remain Claude-only.
facts: Current init previously used a four-file Codex agent whitelist.
.claude/hooks, .claude/settings.json, and .claude/skills are Claude Code runtime assets and should not be copied to .Codex.
Agent prompt markdown files are shared coordination assets and can be transformed for Codex wording.
constraints: Do not mirror Claude-only hooks/settings/skills into .Codex.
Prevent future drift when new .claude/agents/*.md files are added.
Keep existing user-facing Codex fallback guidance for KOALA_ACTIVITY_SOURCE=codex.
